content:
patrick_partner: Hey team — partner wants to run a joint POC with a regulated finance customer next month. They need a quick runbook, expected latency targets, and answers to a security questionnaire. Can we coordinate?

jordan_se: Sure — what's the main ask from the customer? throughput or low tail latency?

patrick_partner: Primary is low tail latency (under 200ms 95th for chat completions) and data isolation. They also want a signed SOC2 section and an offline deployment option.

maria_sales: Pricing question: partner asked if we can offer a short-term discounted Dedicated roster for the 6-week POC. Can we do a promo rate?

jordan_se: For POC we can spin up a small Dedicated pool. Finance can approve a trial credit; ops will need expected RPS and seq lengths to size GPUs.

nisha_ps: I'll draft a runbook. Need to confirm model variants (quantized vs fp16) and whether to enable prefix KV caching to hit latency. Can partner share sample prompt traces?

patrick_partner: I'll request traces — they said avg prompt len ~120 tokens, bursts to 1k tokens, and ~10 RPS.

opsbot: @jordan_se Requested quota for dedicated-poc-gpu created (ticket #POC-481). Autoscale disabled by default.

jordan_se: Notes on deployment options:
```
Partner-hosted VPC <-> VPC peering -> Redwood Private control plane
Model served on Dedicated (pinned version)
KV caching enabled for prefixes, batch size tuned to 1-4 for latency
Fallback route -> hosted small model for failover
```

jordan_se: That architecture satisfies isolation and gives us a path to degrade gracefully.

maria_sales: On pricing: propose 40% off first month for POC + credits to cover egress/network. I'll run this by RevOps.

nisha_ps: Security checklist items I need for the questionnaire: encryption at rest keys (KMS), network topology diagram, data retention policy, access logs, and SOC2 report. @patrick_partner can partner share their security contact?

patrick_partner: Partner sec contact is emily@partnerco.com — copying them into the thread later. Also they asked if we support HSM-backed KMS.

security_bot: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS integrations (Cloud KMS/HSM). See: https://redwood.example/docs/kms-integration (internal doc).

jordan_se: Enterprise blocker note: customer requires on-prem option for certain workloads. We need SOW + legal approval if we ship on-prem. That will add ~4 weeks.

maria_sales: Flagging to AE: timeline note — if on-prem required, POC timeline will stretch past the sales quarter. If they can tolerate VPC peering it's faster.

patrick_partner: Understood. I'll ask them to consider a hybrid: initial POC via VPC peering then evaluate on-prem if needed.

nisha_ps: I'll assemble a one-pager runbook and pre-fill the security questionnaire. ETA EOD tomorrow. Anyone want edits before I send to partner?

jordan_se: I'll review for sizing and latency SLOs.

maria_sales: I'll draft the pricing term and promo.

patrick_partner: Thanks all — will loop in partner sec and schedule a kickoff call for Monday. :thumbsup:
